props.title: What Is Thai Massage?
props.text: Thai massage is a traditional oil-free massage that combines rhythmic pressure with assisted stretching to ease stiffness and help you move more freely. Instead of long strokes with oil, your therapist works with pressure points and guided stretches while you stay in comfortable clothes.
props.feature1Text: Uses guided movements inspired by traditional Thai techniques to help improve flexibility.
props.feature2Text: Applies steady pressure to areas where stiffness and tension commonly build up.

items.question: What is traditional Thai massage?
items.answer: Traditional Thai massage is an oil-free massage that combines pressure, assisted stretching and movement to ease stiffness and help you relax. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, the therapist uses hands, thumbs, palms and elbows for pressure while guiding you through stretches. Sessions run 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1.5 hours.

items.question: Is Thai massage suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Beginners can enjoy a Thai massage at Spa Bali Moon because our therapists adjust the intensity and stretching movements to your comfort level.

items.question: What should I wear for a Thai massage?
items.answer: Wear comfortable clothing you can move in, because a Thai massage at Spa Bali Moon includes stretching and guided movements. No oil is used and you stay in your clothes, at our Seminyak spa and at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Is Thai massage good after a long flight?
items.answer: Yes. Many travellers choose a Thai massage at Spa Bali Moon after long journeys because the stretching techniques can help the body feel less restricted and more comfortable. Your therapist can focus on areas that feel stiff after travelling, such as the back and shoulders.

items.question: Is Thai massage dangerous?
items.answer: Thai massage is generally safe when performed by a trained therapist, but it may not be suitable for everyone. People with certain injuries, medical conditions, or recent surgeries should consult a healthcare professional before having a session. At Spa Bali Moon, tell your therapist about any health concerns first so the pressure and stretching can be adjusted.

items.question: Is Thai massage painful?
items.answer: Thai massage can feel firm or intense, but it should not cause sharp or severe pain. At Spa Bali Moon, the treatment combines pressure from hands, thumbs, palms and elbows with assisted stretching. Your therapist can adjust the pressure and movements to your comfort level, so let them know straight away if anything feels too strong.

items.question: Can I combine Thai massage with other treatments?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon has four Thai massage packages, each including 1 hour of Thai massage. Package C adds a Bali Moon Facial (IDR 425.000), Package A a facial and manicure (IDR 510.000), Package D a cream bath and body scrub (IDR 545.000), and Package B a cream bath and facial (IDR 570.000), all per person.

items.question: How much does Thai massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 133.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 259.000 for 1 hour and IDR 379.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Thai massage packages with a facial, manicure, cream bath or body scrub cost IDR 445.000 to IDR 609.000 per person.

items.question: How long is a Thai massage?
items.answer: Thai massage at Spa Bali Moon runs 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1.5 hours. Thirty minutes suits tight spots when you're short of time; 1 hour gives a more complete body treatment with extra attention to stiff areas, and 1.5 hours is an extended full-body session with more time for mobility work.

items.question: Where can I get a Thai massage in Seminyak?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon offers Thai massage at our spa in Seminyak (Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30) and at your villa or hotel, where home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. We have been in business since 2009 and are open daily, 9am to 11pm. Book on WhatsApp, +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: Can I have a Thai massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything a Thai massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a Thai massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my Thai massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your Thai massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
